rationale.selected_continuation_source: proposal_004 is the strongest non-control overall candidate from generation_003, with the highest observed Q_total (2.8688) and the best cross-benchmark result, so it becomes the primary continuation source.
rationale.alternate_exploit_anchor: proposal_003 is the strongest non-control balanced exploit-style fallback among the remaining successful units, with solid Q_total 1.7759 and better balance than the calibration-heavy alternatives.
rationale.mode: Balanced mode remains preferred because generation_003 produced one dominant jump winner (proposal_004) plus a credible exploit-style anchor (proposal_003).
rationale.control_exclusion: proposal_008 is excluded from advancement choice because it is the control replicate, even though it outperformed several non-control variants.
other_notes: proposal_005 remained positive but clearly below proposal_004 and below the control replicate.
proposal_006 underperformed badly on RMD17 despite decent ISO17 behavior, so it should not be advanced.
proposal_002 lacks a complete benchmark-centric Q_total in the current collected state and is not used as the continuation source.
